rule.description: Within the coturn server-runtime translation units, an internal-linkage entity (a static function or a function-scope variable) may not remain in the source without any live use after the reachable path that invoked it has been removed from the supported configuration.
rule.implementation: Clang-Tidy 18 configured with the compiler -Wunused-function/-Wunused-variable/-Wunused-const-variable/-Wunused-but-set-variable/-Wunused-label diagnostics activated through --extra-arg and surfaced as the clang-diagnostic-unused-* checks; unrelated default analyzer families are subtracted, and only the clang-diagnostic-unused-* family is interpreted. Scope: translation units of the server runtime derived from the CMake compile database (src/server, src/client, src/apps/relay, src/apps/common, src/prometheus/prom.c), excluding vendored libtelnet.c and the standalone command-line tool directories.

checks.description: Report every static function or function-scope variable in the server-runtime translation units that is defined but never used or never read.
checks.detected_relation: internal-linkage production entity -> no remaining live use after its entry path was removed
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: An implementation retained in the source with no reachable role under any supported configuration is obsolete code left behind by an incomplete feature retirement; it is exactly the dead-code relation of this task.

matches.evidence: The static request handler that processed cookie-less RFC 3489 Binding requests (parsing, legacy-form binding/error response construction, legacy server-attribute attachment) is defined after the dispatch branch that selected it was removed; no remaining call site exists in the server runtime.
The function-scope cookie marker in the request-dispatch loop (read_client_connection) was only consumed by the removed else-if dispatch branch; it is now declared and never read.

The same cookie marker pattern in the UDP listener fast path (classify_udp_packet) fed the removed classification branch that recognized cookie-less requests; it is now declared and never read, one component away from E1/E2, showing the rule is not dispatch-local.

excluded.reason: A pre-existing unused static helper in the turnutils_uclient load-generation command-line tool. Tool directories are outside the server-runtime scope of the rule (they are test utilities, not part of the turnserver component), and the entity is unrelated to the retired mechanism.

excluded.ref: src/client/ns_turn_msg.c:old_stun_is_command_message_str, old_stun_init_error_response_str, stun_set_binding_response_str legacy parameters, OLD_STUN_ATTRIBUTE_* macros
excluded.reason: Exported (external-linkage) API of the shared client wire library, exercised by tests/test_stun_msg.c and external consumers. The rule covers internal-linkage entities only, and removing exported API would change a supported contract rather than an internal leftover.

excluded.ref: src/apps/relay/dtls_listener.c UDP_PACKET_CLASS_OLD_STUN enumerator and the tolerated OLD_STUN_ATTRIBUTE_RESPONSE_ADDRESS cases in the listener pre-filter and binding-attribute switch
excluded.reason: An unproducible classification category and tolerated legacy-attribute parsing are residue of the same retirement, but they are not internal-linkage entities without use in the rule's sense: the enumerator never triggers an unused diagnostic, and the attribute-tolerance cases remain reachable live parsing paths. The canonical ground-truth repair removes or keeps them as part of the same task; the rule does not count them as matches.

excluded.ref: src/apps/relay/libtelnet.c and remaining src/apps/* tool directories (uclient, peer, stunclient, rfc5769, oauth, natdiscovery)
excluded.reason: Vendored third-party code and command-line utilities outside the server-runtime scope of the rule.
